title.en: Logs, audit trail and user activity (phone)

intro.sr: Sistem beleži tri vrste tragova: tehničke logove sajta, audit log (ko je šta izmenio) i aktivnost korisnika (šta posetioci rade). Ovde je objašnjeno čemu služi svaki i kada ga otvoriti. Snimljeno na telefonu (390x844).
intro.en: The system keeps three kinds of traces: technical site logs, the audit log (who changed what) and user activity (what visitors do). This explains what each is for and when to open it. Recorded on a phone (390x844).
